capabilities: monitor all worktrees of a configured git repo in a live panel
show agent presence dots from Claude Code session transcripts
diff changed files per worktree against the merge-base and render previews
commit all changes, push the branch, and create a pull request via gh
extras: Desktop only; per Obsidian developer policies it discloses reading files outside the vault (including ~/.claude/projects/ transcripts), shelling out to git and gh, and that network use happens only on explicit PR creation.
motivation: The author built it for the parallel-agent era: 'your vault becomes the cockpit for repos changing beneath it. Built for the parallel-agent era'.
problem: Obsidian git plugins version the vault itself; none let you watch external git worktrees and AI agent sessions changing from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: a pulsing dot on any worktree where a Claude Code session is actively writing
opens a pull request (via gh, with a GitHub compare-page fallback)

summary: Git worktree monitoring panel that shows live changes and AI agent activity in repo worktrees, with one-click commit and PR creation.
